card.title: Hope with Me
card.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me choose celebration glasses for when our café application gets approved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're on the waiting list. I haven't even told my mum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then just believe it with me here. Which glasses belong in our café?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: These two. Mum would insist on a mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose her mug too. You just pictured our first customer.

mechanism: A invites shared belief in an uncertain cafe by having B choose concrete objects for its future customers.
confusable: Unlike pretending approval already exists, A must acknowledge thin evidence while recruiting imaginative participation.
comparison: D103-b expands B's two glasses into Mum's mug; D103-a expands B's dad at a loading bay into a possible audience.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
